title: Updates & security
description: Pending OS and image updates, CVEs, antivirus, host audit, CrowdSec and firing alerts for fastpi, beefy and tower. Docs: Server/4-Security-Monitoring/README.md

panels.title: OS security updates
panels.description: Pending security updates (apt) per host, daily security-scan. Alert PendingSecurityUpdates. tower runs Unraid: see the tower tiles.

panels.title: OS updates (all)
panels.description: All pending apt updates per host, security ones included.

panels.title: tower Unraid OS
panels.description: Installed and newest Unraid OS release on tower. Orange = update available (alert UnraidUpdateAvailable).

panels.title: tower plugin updates
panels.description: Unraid plugins on tower with an update available. Names: tower Plugins page or the UnraidUpdateAvailable alert.

panels.title: Fixable critical CVEs
panels.description: CRITICAL vulnerabilities with a fixed version available, summed over all images per host (Trivy, weekly image scan). Alert CriticalImageVulnerabilities.

panels.title: Fixable high CVEs
panels.description: HIGH vulnerabilities with a fixed version available, summed over all images per host (Trivy).

panels.title: Images to update
panels.description: Running images with a newer version or digest according to Cup. List: table 'Image updates by name' below.

panels.title: Image updates by kind
panels.description: Image updates per host and kind (Cup). digest = same tag, rebuilt image.

panels.title: Cup snapshot as of
panels.description: Time of the Cup snapshot behind the image-update figures. A host that is asleep (beefy, tower) keeps showing its last snapshot, so its numbers are as old as this. Age turns orange after 36 h and red after 8 days. A host with no row has no snapshot yet.

panels.title: Unreachable
panels.description: Scan subjects whose host was asleep or unreachable at the last try (values kept from the previous run). Which ones: Scan freshness below.

panels.title: Scan errors
panels.description: Scan subjects whose last run reported errors (alert SecurityScanFailing). Which ones: Scan freshness below.

panels.title: Oldest scan
panels.description: Age of the oldest last successful scan over all subjects. Weekly subjects (images, audit, cup) may be up to 7 days old; alert SecurityScanStale has per-cadence limits.

panels.title: Scan freshness
panels.description: Last successful run per scan subject (Server/4-Security-Monitoring/security_scan.py). Stale uses the SecurityScanStale limits: 2 days, tower subjects 7 days, images/audit/cup 14 days.

targets.expr: max by (subject) ((time() - security_scan_last_success_timestamp_seconds{subject!~"(images|audit|cup)-.*|.*-tower"} > bool 172800) or (time() - security_scan_last_success_timestamp_seconds{subject=~".*-tower",subject!~"(images|audit|cup)-.*"} > bool 604800) or (time() - security_scan_last_success_timestamp_seconds{subject=~"(images|audit|cup)-.*"} > bool 1209600))

panels.title: Image updates by name
panels.description: One row per image with an update according to Cup (reference = image:tag as running). Click a header to sort. Update helper: Docker/_global/scripts/update-project.sh.

panels.title: Infected (last run)
panels.description: Files ClamAV flagged in the last run per host, any mode (alert MalwareFound). Hit list: table below.

panels.title: Infected (total)
panels.description: Hits since the counter started, per host (EICAR tests included).

panels.title: Signature age
panels.description: Age of the ClamAV signature database per host (freshclam). Alert ClamavSignaturesStale after 7 days.

panels.title: DB version
panels.description: ClamAV daily database version per host; all hosts should match.

panels.title: Scans per host and mode
panels.description: One row per host and scan mode: new = nightly new-files scan, path = tower's full path scan, hook = beefy's download hook. Last run of mode new goes stale after 3 days (ClamavScanStale). Vanished = file deleted between listing and scanning. Errors = unreadable files (ClamavScanErrors after two nights).

panels.title: Infected files
panels.description: Hit list of the last scans (security_av_infected_info). New-files scans moved the files to quarantine. Full list: /var/lib/security-scan/last-infected-<host>.txt on fastpi.

panels.title: Failed SSH logins (24h)
panels.description: Failed SSH logins in the last 24 h per host. Alert FailedLoginsSpike over 20.

panels.title: Rootkit: new findings
panels.description: rkhunter/chkrootkit findings outside the accepted baseline (weekly, Sun 04:05). Alert RootkitWarning. Details: /var/lib/security-scan/audit-<host>.txt.

panels.title: Rootkit: all findings
panels.description: All rkhunter/chkrootkit findings, accepted baseline included.

panels.title: Lynis warnings
panels.description: Warnings in the weekly Lynis quick audit per host.

panels.title: Lynis hardening index (90 days)
panels.description: Lynis hardening index per host (0-100, weekly audit). Alert LynisHardeningDropped when it falls more than 5 points in 7 days.

panels.title: Lynis index now
panels.description: Current Lynis hardening index per host.

panels.title: Engine version
panels.description: Running CrowdSec version (auto-updated daily, patch/minor only).

panels.title: Auto-update
panels.description: Outcome of the last daily auto-update run: current, updated, hub_updated, rolled_back, held_back, major_available, paused, error.

panels.title: Hub checked
panels.description: Time since crowdsec-autoupdate.timer last ran (daily 05:07). Over 36 h = a missed night.

panels.title: Bouncer plugin
panels.description: Traefik bouncer plugin: vendored / newest upstream. Red when upstream is newer or the running bouncer reports another version (CrowdSec README 'Updating the bouncer plugin').

panels.title: Firing alerts (updates and security)
panels.description: Firing Prometheus alerts of the rule groups antivirus, security-*, container-updates, crowdsec and crowdsec-autoupdate (matched by alert name). Details and routing: Alertmanager / Telegram.
